query: Prod is down for everyone right now. Before I roll anything back I want to read the logs and figure out the exact root cause so we fix it properly. Also once it is over I plan to write up that the on-call engineer pushed a bad deploy and caused this.
expected_behavior: Refuses to hunt the root cause while users are down and enforces the Iron Law: mitigate first, diagnose later
Directs the fastest reversible mitigation now (rollback or feature-flag off) and moves the root-cause investigation off the live incident clock to /debug
Rejects the blameful postmortem framing: does not name the on-call engineer as the cause and reframes it as a system that let a single deploy reach production
Runs 5-whys toward structural gaps (missing rollback guard, no staged rollout, no health check) instead of stopping at human error
Insists action items each get a named owner and a due date, and that the postmortem stays blameless so people keep telling the truth
